rrhh.titulo: Applications to join a job pool
rrhh.ayuda: 1. Choose a recruitment process, including one whose deadline has passed. 2. Open each application, check the requirements and admit or reject it. 3. Once the final list is approved, add the applicant to the job pool with the record number.
rrhh.no_disponible: Reviewing job pool applications is not switched on yet.
rrhh.denegada: Your current access does not allow you to view these applications. If you should have access, contact the permissions manager.
rrhh.error: Applications could not be loaded. Select Retry. If the problem continues, contact IT support.
rrhh.error_convocatorias: Recruitment processes could not be loaded. Select Retry. If the problem continues, contact IT support.
rrhh.error_decision: The decision could not be confirmed. Select Confirm again with the same details. If the problem continues, contact IT support.
rrhh.conflicto: The application has changed since you opened it. Refresh the list and check its status before deciding.
rrhh.falta_acta: The applicant could not be added: the final list is not yet recorded as approved. Check the record number and confirm again.
rrhh.identidad_pendiente: The applicant could not be identified with certainty. Ask Administration to check their identity, then confirm this same application again.
rrhh.regla_incompatible: The admission rules have changed. Refresh the list and review the application again.
rrhh.evidencia_invalida: That record number was not recognised. Check it and confirm again.
rrhh.plazo_cerrado: The application period for this recruitment process has ended. Refresh the list and check the application status.
rrhh.vacio: There are no applications with this status. Change the status or choose another recruitment process.
rrhh.vacio_convocatorias: There are no published recruitment processes you can manage with this access. If you expected one, contact the person responsible.
rrhh.requisitos_pendientes: Some mandatory requirements are not verified. Review the documents before admitting the applicant.
rrhh.motivos_no_disponibles: No rejection reasons are available for this application. Contact the person responsible for admission rules.
rrhh.confirmar_incorporacion: Confirm entry into the job pool
rrhh.admitida_a_convocatoria: The application has been admitted to the recruitment process. Entry into the job pool awaits the final list.
rrhh.incorporada: The applicant has been added to the job pool.
rrhh.error_detalle: The application could not be opened. Select Retry. If the problem continues, contact IT support.
rrhh.evidencia_pista: It appears at the top of the published record.
rrhh.paso_admitida_a_convocatoria: Once the final list is approved, add the applicant to the job pool.
rrhh.paso_incorporada: Nothing else to do on this application.
rrhh.paso_rechazada: Nothing else to do on this application.
rrhh.resumen_decision: You are about to {accion} the application from {persona} for {categoria}.
